hello: Hi! The bowl here is taller than the HaTeder pool, and more forgiving. I've got a spare board if you want it.
first: This bowl sits on the ground, so you climb the slope and drop in off the lip. {k:W} on the way down gives you speed. That's pumping.
Hit the wall fast and you fly. In the air {k:J} is a kickflip, {k:K} a grab, {k:A} {k:D} a 180 spin. Land with the board along the wall.
At the lip, or on the bar in the middle, {k:L} is a grind. A few tricks in a row without falling is a combo, and it's worth a lot more. You get one minute.
go: Take the red board. It forgives anyone who respects it.
after: {score}! Nice. Your best: {best}. One more round?
again: {score}. The bowl beats everyone at first. Your best is still {best}.
best: {score}?! New best! I'm posting that to the park group chat.
quit: The bowl isn't going anywhere. I'm here until they switch the lights off.
later: Cool. I'm here until they switch the lights off.
